summary: Run integration tests in the same Docker or Podman containers CI uses; set ANSIBLE_TEST_PREFER_PODMAN to prefer Podman, and on non-Linux Docker try --docker-privileged if tests fail.
questions: How do I make ansible-test use Podman instead of Docker?
Why do integration tests fail with Docker on macOS?

answer_card.title: Tests in containers
answer_card.answer_md: Use CI's containers on Linux with Docker or Podman. Podman is used only if the Docker CLI is missing, unless you set `ANSIBLE_TEST_PREFER_PODMAN`. Docker on macOS isn't recommended; `--docker-privileged` (for `integration` only) may help.
